anchors.description_en: Melos is a simple shepherd (not a politician) who bravely speaks out against the tyrant.
anchors.description_ja: メロスは政治がわからぬ村の牧人で、暴君に直接異を唱える主人公。

anchors.description_en: The ruler is a tyrant (fearful of enemies) who executes people on suspicion, without fair trials.
anchors.description_ja: 王は人を疑い、公正な裁きなしに処刑する邪智暴虐の暴君。

anchors.description_en: Melos has a close friend who stays behind as a hostage in his place and trusts him; the friend relationship (mutual trust) is the emotional core.
anchors.description_ja: メロスには身代わり人質として残り、彼を信じる親友がいる。この友という関係(相互の信頼)が物語の核。

anchors.description_en: Melos denounces the tyrant and is sentenced to death.
anchors.description_ja: メロスが暴君を批判し、死刑を宣告される。

anchors.description_en: Melos is granted three days to attend his sister's wedding, with his friend held hostage until he returns.
anchors.description_ja: 妹の結婚式に出るため3日間の猶予を得て、その間は友が人質に残る。

anchors.description_en: On the way back, obstacles (a flooded/wild river and attackers/bandits) delay and weaken him.
anchors.description_ja: 帰路で川(増水)や襲撃者などの障害に遭い、遅れて消耗する。

anchors.description_en: At his lowest point, exhausted, Melos is tempted to give up and let his friend die.
anchors.description_ja: どん底で疲れ果て、友を見捨てて諦めたくなる誘惑に陥る。

anchors.description_en: He revives and recommits to his promise through trust in his friend.
anchors.description_ja: 友への信頼と約束を思い出して立ち上がり、再び走り出す。

anchors.description_en: Melos arrives at the execution ground just in time, at the last moment.
anchors.description_ja: メロスが刑場に処刑の直前、ぎりぎりで間に合う。

anchors.description_en: Cause->effect: Melos's open denunciation of the tyrant is why he is sentenced to death (the tyrant's cruelty comes first; Melos reacts to it).
anchors.description_ja: 因果: 暴君の悪行に怒ったメロスが直接批判したことが死刑宣告の原因(暴君の悪行が先、メロスの批判はそれへの反応)。

anchors.description_en: Cause->effect: the friend voluntarily stays as hostage out of trust, which is what makes Melos's promise life-or-death (if he fails to return, the friend dies).
anchors.description_ja: 因果: 友が信頼から自ら人質に残ることで、メロスが戻れなければ友が死ぬという約束の重みが生まれる。

anchors.description_en: Cause->effect: Melos recovers his resolve because he remembers his friend's trust and his own promise (not because of fear or outside force).
anchors.description_ja: 因果: メロスが立ち直るのは、友の信頼と自分の約束を思い出したから(恐れや外圧のためではない)。

anchors.description_en: Cause->effect: Melos keeping his promise and the two friends' mutual loyalty is what saves the friend and moves the ruler to change.
anchors.description_ja: 因果: メロスが約束を守り二人が互いに信じ抜いたことが、友の救出と王の心の変化(改心)の原因。

anchors.description_en: Overall order of events: denounces tyrant/sentenced -> three-day grace with friend as hostage -> journey back with obstacles (river, attackers) -> exhaustion and temptation to give up -> renewed resolve -> arrival just in time -> friend freed and ruler changed.
anchors.description_ja: 全体の順序: 批判・死刑宣告 -> 3日の猶予と友の人質 -> 帰路の障害(川・襲撃) -> 疲労と諦めの誘惑 -> 立ち直り -> 間に合う -> 友の救出と王の改心。

anchors.description_en: Ending: Melos is in time, the friend is freed (nobody dies), and the ruler is moved by their loyalty and mutual trust and changes his heart.
anchors.description_ja: 結末: 間に合い、友は解放され(誰も死なない)、王は二人の信実に心を動かされて改心する。

anchors.description_en: Charm: the theme that trust and loyalty between friends is real and stronger than the tyrant's cynicism; an emotional low point followed by a hopeful, moving finish.
anchors.description_ja: 魅力: 友情・信実は空虚な妄想ではなく暴君の疑いより強いという主題と、どん底からの感動的な立ち直り。

anchors.description_en: Charm: the race against time/the setting sun (deadline tension) as Melos runs back to the city.
anchors.description_ja: 魅力: 日没までに間に合うかという時間との競走の緊迫感。

anchors.description_en: No major new facts/events/characters invented that change the story (e.g., supernatural helpers, new relatives, extra villains, different motives). Simplification and re-wording are fine.
anchors.description_ja: 物語を変えるような重大な新Fact(超自然の助け手、新たな親族、追加の敵、別の動機など)が捏造されていないこと。簡略化・言い換えは許容。

forbidden_endings.description_ja: 間に合わない結末(末尾段落で'too late'等)
友が死ぬ/処刑される結末(末尾段落)
王が改心しない/約束を反故にする結末(末尾段落)
